svg.text: Pick one per row — A or B. Same language as the set: 24 grid, 1.5 stroke, square ends, one node.
An agent you can recognise: a machine head whose antenna light is the brand node.
A figure at work: head, shoulders, and the node as its focus.
A smaller bot hanging from its parent's node — the trace branch from the logo.
A small bot in front of a bigger one — an agent with a helper.
Language + generation: a speech bubble with the AI spark inside.
Lines of text turning into an answer: the model at work.
Built-in machinery (ls, read_file, task…): a cog, cut with straight teeth.
Comes with the framework: a box — what the library ships.
The universal sign for a tool, drawn precise: an open jaw at 45°.
A tool you swing: head and handle, square-cut.
